visual.description: Full-viewport video background with centered text overlay ('THE ART OF LEATHER GOODS') and a single CTA link below, no column split.
Fixed header with icon on far left, centered logo+wordmark, icon on far right; secondary nav bar below with 4 evenly-spaced text links centered.
Three equal-width product cards on a light cream background, each with a centered product image above a two-line text label.
Two unequal editorial image columns (left column narrower, right column wider) under a full-width centered heading 'EXPLORE THE WORLD OF GOYARD'.
Left column holds stacked heading text and a CTA link; right column is a large product photograph that bleeds to the right edge, with no visible gutter.
Full-width dark photograph with large white overlay headline text at bottom-left, no column structure.
Three equal-width product cards on a cream background under centered heading 'THE SEASONS OF GOYARD', each with a centered image and a single text label.
Left half contains heading, body copy, and an email input with subscribe button; right half contains an illustrated mascot image, on a white background.
Full-width dark green section showing a centered focal card flanked by two partially-visible cards with prev/next arrow controls.
Medium-green footer with four equal-width columns (CUSTOMER SERVICE, MAISON GOYARD, LEGAL INFORMATION, ACCESSIBILITY) each containing stacked text links.
Full-width dark green band with centered monogram logo, wordmark, social icon row in a single horizontal line, and copyright line at bottom-right.
